notes:
Genesis Engine 0.7.0 - November 2026

Editor: Unreal 5.7 look and workflow (same layout, panels and shortcuts, drawn by Genesis with Genesis icons).
Nothing from Epic is used. This release is the editor shell only; see "Not in 0.7" at the end.

Docking:
- New docking framework: every panel is a tab you can drag, split, stack, float into another group, close and
  reopen from the Window menu. Splitters resize, drop zones show where a dragged tab will go, and a tab menu has
  Close, Close Other Tabs and Maximize Tab. Layouts are saved per project (Saved/Config/EditorLayout.ini) or per user (%LOCALAPPDATA%\Genesis) and come
  back on the next start. Window > Reset Layout restores the default.
- New default layout like Unreal's: Viewport in the middle, Outliner above Details on the right, a status bar with
  Content Drawer, Output Log and the Cmd console at the bottom. Content Drawer (Ctrl+Space) and Output Log (`) slide
  up over the viewport and can be docked into the layout with one click.

Toolbars, viewport and console:
- New main toolbar: Save, Source Control, Content, Selection / Place mode menu, Quick Add, Settings, Build, C++,
  Play with its drop-down (viewport, simulate), Pause, Stop, Eject (F8) and the platform menu.
- New viewport toolbar: Perspective / orthographic menu (Top, Bottom, Left, Right, Front, Back), view modes (Lit,
  Unlit, Wireframe, Detail Lighting, Lighting Only, Reflections, Normals, Ambient Occlusion), Show flags, transform
  tools, grid / rotation / scale snapping with value pickers, camera speed, FOV, game view (G), maximise (Ctrl+B).
- Orthographic viewports with a grid, and a multi-viewport layout (1, 2 side by side, 2 stacked, 4) where each
  viewport has its own camera, view type and view mode.
- Place Actors panel (Recently Placed, Basic, Lights, Shapes, Visual Effects, Volumes, All Classes) with search; click or drag a class
  into the viewport to place it.
- Console: the Cmd row in the status bar and in the Output Log runs commands (help, stat fps/unit/gpu, show, viewmode,
  viewtype, layout, t.MaxFPS, r.ScreenPercentage, fov, camspeed, save, open, play, simulate, stop, pause,
  resetlayout, quit) with history (Up / Down) and Tab auto-complete.

Panels:
- Details: component tree (Self, StaticMeshComponent, Collision), search and filter bar, sections with reset-to-default
  arrows, Add button, advanced foldouts, tags editor. The Skeletal Mesh section only shows for actors that have a
  model.
- Outliner: Item Label / Type columns, search with type:, tag: and folder: filters, actor folders (drag to move,
  create, rename), visibility eye, multi-select with Ctrl / Shift, actor count and selection count.
- New Project Settings (Description, Maps & Modes, Packaging, Input, Physics, Rendering, Collision, Audio, General
  Settings) and Editor Preferences (General, Viewports, Keyboard Shortcuts, Source Code, Appearance), both docked
  panels reachable from the Settings menu, with a search box.
- Rebindable keyboard shortcuts with conflict detection (Editor Preferences > Keyboard Shortcuts): Ctrl+S, Ctrl+Z / Y,
  Ctrl+C / X / V, Ctrl+W and Ctrl+D duplicate, Delete, F2, Ctrl+A, Q W E R, F focus, End snap to floor, F11 immersive
  viewport, Ctrl+Space Content Drawer, ` Output Log, Ctrl+Alt+H Undo History, Ctrl+Shift+P Project Settings.
- New Undo History panel.
- Output Log: Filters (verbosity and per-category), search, Clear, Copy, and the Cmd command row. The status bar
  shows the number of new warnings.
- Content Browser: Add Filter bar (type filters), favourites, collections, folder colour tags, tile size slider,
  tile / list views, the Import and Add buttons, view settings saved per project, and a Dock in Layout button in the
  drawer.
- The C++ Editor, Profiler and Visualizer are ordinary dock tabs now.

Fixes and polish:
- Tab bars shrink only their longest tabs instead of all of them, so short names such as "Details" are not cut.
- The "(Persistent Level)" label in the Outliner hides when the panel is too narrow instead of overlapping the Type column.
- Details: legacy sections (Collision, Rigid Body, Character, Spring Arm, C++ properties) line up with the new rows.

Not in 0.7 (planned for later versions):
- Landscape / terrain tools, foliage, PCG (procedural content generation).
- Lumen-style global illumination (screen-space GI and probe GI are on the roadmap), Niagara-style particles.
- Sequencer (cinematics), Control Rig, a material graph editor, AI tools (behaviour trees, navigation), a UI designer,
  an audio mixer.
- Alt+drag duplicate: Alt + left mouse orbits the camera in Genesis, so duplicating is Ctrl+D / Ctrl+W.
- Floating OS windows for panels (panels dock inside the main window), Blueprints (excluded by design).
